entities.name: Sulfite reductase beta-component
observations: The 588-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A6VPZ1 from Actinobacillus succinogenes.
The protein is the hemoprotein beta-component of the NADPH-dependent sulfite reductase complex.
It binds one siroheme and one [4Fe-4S] cluster per subunit.
Pfam matches include NIR_SIR_ferr and NIR_SIR domains characteristic of sulfite/nitrite reductase hemoproteins.

entities.name: Sulfite reduction to sulfide
observations: Overall NADPH-dependent reaction: sulfite + 3 NADPH + 3 H2O + 4 H+ → hydrogen sulfide + 3 NADP+; equivalent database direction may be written in reverse.
The reaction is a six-electron reduction of sulfite to sulfide, carried out by the sulfite reductase complex.

entities.name: Siroheme and [4Fe-4S] cofactors
observations: The beta-component binds one siroheme and one [4Fe-4S] cluster per subunit, supporting multi-electron oxyanion reduction.
